name: rigshare-mcp
description: Rent GPUs, robots, drones, and construction gear on RIGShare; also onboards equipment owners.
author: RIGShare LLC <support@rigshare.app>

scripts.test: tsc && node test/tools.test.mjs && node test/interface.test.mjs && node test/build-output.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (process.env.RIGSHARE_MCP_PUBLISH_CHECKED !== '1') { console.error('Refusing to publish from a directory. Pack the package, check the tarball, then publish the tarball: npm publish ./rigshare-mcp-<version>.tgz'); process.exit(1); }"
